AI for Investment Research

Beginner class · Taught by Nigel Tan

Join Nigel for a planned introductory class on working with company reports. Practise asking questions about a business and tracing an AI-generated summary back to its source.

Try a class exercise

Dates and enrolment will be announced here.

Inside

What we’ll practise

  • Find a company’s own description of its business
  • Compare a summary with the original report
  • Build a list of questions for further research

Class notebook

A warm-up before class

Choose a paragraph from a published annual report that describes what the company sells. Ask an AI tool to explain it in three sentences. Next to each sentence, copy the phrase from the report that supports it. Set aside any claim you cannot trace.
